It was an honor to participate in @RepBlakeMoore's Special Order last night commemorating Veterans Day on the House Floor. 

To every veteran, thank you for your service and your unwavering commitment to our country. https://t.co/N6C3zNV8qx

250 years of freedom, paid for by those who wore the uniform. 

Read my op-ed in @yhn ⬇️
https://t.co/2ckdQP3Hqm

I enjoyed speaking at Shades Mountain Baptist Church's Salute to Veterans program last week.

We are forever grateful to our veterans for their service and sacrifice, and I thank Shades Mountain Baptist Church for hosting this special event in their honor and inviting me to be a part of it.

Today, join me in honoring the brave men and women who have served our nation. Their service and sacrifice have preserved our freedoms for 250 years.

To all who have worn the uniform, thank you. We owe you a debt of gratitude that can never be repaid. #VeteransDay https://t.co/e82LVC5Kpl

On Friday, I had the privilege of presenting a replacement Bronze Star Medal to Sergeant First Class Henry A. Todd.

Sergeant Todd served in the U.S. Army for over 20 years, including a tour of duty in Vietnam, where he was awarded the Bronze Star. After his original medal was lost over the years, it was an honor to present him with a replacement and thank him in person for his service to our nation.

Congratulations, Sergeant Todd, and thank you for your service!

For 251 years, Marines have answered the call to defend our nation with unwavering courage, honor, and commitment.

Thank you to all who have earned the title of United States Marine. 🇺🇸 https://t.co/45tmzR8YXZ

The Trump Administration announced an additional $199,278,801 for Alabama through the Rural Health Transformation Program.

This historic investment is a tremendous win for rural Alabama and will help improve healthcare for families and communities across our state. https://t.co/4KKOn5xbOD https://t.co/wKROUDXE1Z

By passing the Working Families Tax Cuts, Republicans delivered real results for the American people.

✅No tax on tips

✅$50 billion for rural healthcare

Every Democrat voted AGAINST this legislation.

financial_disclosures.caption: Official House financial disclosure filings from the Clerk of the House. A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. This page links to the Clerk's copies and does not score anyone.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
